name: Project Genesis – Proof-of-concept of tokenised green bonds
issuer: Hong Kong Monetary Authority / BIS Innovation Hub HK
key_participants: BIS Innovation Hub Hong Kong Centre
description: Proof-of-concept conducted with the BIS Innovation Hub Hong Kong Centre to concept-test the issuance of tokenised green bonds in Hong Kong and lay the foundation for real-money tokenised bond transactions.
notes: Described in the EvergreenHub timeline as a 2021 proof-of-concept of tokenised bonds that concept-tested tokenised green bond issuance in Hong Kong and informed later real-money deals.

name: HKSAR Government’s Inaugural Tokenised Green Bond Offering
issuer: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
key_participants: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
technical_stack: Digital bond structure implemented on a DLT-based platform and integrated with Hong Kong’s existing market infrastructure for issuance, trading and settlement.
description: First tokenised government green bond issuance globally under the Government Green Bond Programme, using DLT to support the full bond lifecycle and shortening primary settlement from typical T+5 to T+1.
notes: Tokenised issuance size was HK$800 million and is highlighted in EvergreenHub as the first tokenised government green bond in the world.

name: HKSAR Government’s Digital Green Bonds Offering (Second Tokenised Issuance)
issuer: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
key_participants: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
technical_stack: Digital bond platform supporting multi-currency issuance, lifecycle events and on-chain accessibility of green bond information.
description: Second tokenised government green bond deal and the world’s first multi-currency digital bond, issuing around HK$6 billion equivalent in HKD, RMB, USD and EUR.
notes: Described as the first multi-currency digital bond in the world, attracting a broad investor base including asset managers, banks, insurers, private banks and non-financial institutions.

name: HKSAR Government’s Third Digital Green Bonds Offering
issuer: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
key_participants: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
Bank of Communications Co., Ltd. Hong Kong Branch
technical_stack: Digital bond issuance executed on the HSBC Orion permissioned DLT platform with clearing and settlement via the HKMA’s Central Moneymarkets Unit (CMU).
description: Third digital green bond issuance under the Government Green Bond Programme, further scaling tokenised bond adoption in Hong Kong.
notes: Press release specifies HSBC Orion as the digital platform and CMU as the clearing and settlement system; continues the Project Evergreen digital bond trajectory.

name: Digital Bond Grant Scheme (DBGS)
description: HKMA grant scheme offering issuers up to HK$2.5 million per eligible digital bond issuance in Hong Kong to incentivise tokenised and digital bond deals.
notes: Referenced in EvergreenHub as part of HKMA’s efforts to promote broader adoption of digital bonds; formal terms are set out in the Guideline on the Digital Bond Grant Scheme.

name: EvergreenHub – Digital Bond Knowledge Repository
description: HKMA’s online digital bond knowledge repository under Project Evergreen, sharing materials on tokenised bond transactions.
notes: Consolidates HKMA’s digital bond journey from Project Genesis through multiple tokenised bond issuances and provides guidance such as the HKMA paper on Bond Tokenisation in Hong Kong.

name: Project Ensemble Sandbox – Asset Tokenisation Use Case Platform
key_participants: BIS Innovation Hub Hong Kong Centre
technical_stack: Multi-ledger sandbox environment connecting participating banks’ tokenised deposit platforms to an interoperability layer for PvP and DvP settlement.
description: HKMA-led sandbox for interbank settlement using experimental tokenised money for transactions involving tokenised assets.
notes: Press release highlights four main asset-tokenisation themes and collaboration with SFC, industry and academia.

name: EnsembleTX – Project Ensemble Pilot Platform for Tokenised Deposits and Digital Assets
technical_stack: Built on Project Ensemble Sandbox to support real-value PvP and DvP settlement of tokenised deposits and digital assets.
description: Pilot phase of Project Ensemble enabling real-value transactions involving tokenised deposits and digital assets, initially focusing on tokenised money market fund transactions.
notes: Described by HKMA as a shift from PoCs to live-value tokenised deposit and asset settlement in Hong Kong.

name: SFC Circular on tokenisation of SFC-authorised investment products (ref. 23EC53)
issuer: Securities and Futures Commission – Investment Products Division
key_participants: Securities and Futures Commission – Investment Products Division
technical_stack: Principles-based requirements for tokenisation arrangements using DLT, including permissioned structures and smart contract audits where requested.
description: Circular setting out conditions for allowing tokenisation of SFC-authorised investment products offered to the public in Hong Kong.
notes: References intermediaries’ circular and sets expectations on record keeping, smart contract integrity, cybersecurity and disclosure.

name: SFC Circular on intermediaries engaging in tokenised securities-related activities (ref. 23EC52)
technical_stack: Guidance on using DLT in tokenised securities, including expectations by DLT archetype and risk controls.
description: Guidance to intermediaries on dealing, advising, managing and trading tokenised securities and funds investing in tokenised securities.
notes: Clarifies that existing requirements for traditional securities apply equally to tokenised securities, with additional focus on technology and ownership risks.

name: SFC Circular ref. 25EC57 – Updated guidance on digital assets including tokenised securities and stablecoins
description: Updated circular providing guidance to intermediaries on activities involving digital assets, including tokenised securities and stablecoins.
notes: Updates and extends the 2 November 2023 circular on intermediaries engaging in tokenised securities-related activities.

name: Presentation Materials – Tokenisation of SFC-authorised investment products
issuer: Securities and Futures Commission – Investment Products Division
key_participants: Securities and Futures Commission – Investment Products Division
technical_stack: Educational material on blockchain-based tokens, DLT and smart contracts for tokenising investment products and some real world assets.
description: Slide deck explaining tokenisation concepts, SFC’s regulatory remit and key considerations for tokenising SFC-authorised investment products.
notes: Linked from the SFC’s FAQs; complements the November 2023 tokenisation circulars.
